verdict.rationale: Lium documents several keyless public endpoints for checking GPU prices and availability before renting: a JSON feed of every rentable node, a public price CSV, an availability WebSocket, MCP tools `search_gpus` and `get_gpu_prices`, and the public prices in llms.txt. A CLI `lium quote` command also prices a job before renting with no API key. missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification that the JSON nodes feed and pricing endpoints return live data (only llms.txt was probed as reachable).

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability from a public or documented endpoint before committing any spend

citations.quote: Every rentable GPU node on Lium in one JSON call. No key, no signup.
